Statute: LSA pregnancy leave 17 alongside c1 (c22) -> LSA parental leave 61 (c23) to week 78 (version_uncertain).

Non-birth parent chain: Supplemented Parental Leave 15 weeks (c5; 100% salary weeks 1-2 c6, then top-up to 100% with EI weeks 3-15 c7) -> Parental Leave Without Pay to a one-year total, 37 weeks (c9; leave limit 52). EI parental 35 weeks from week 2 (c8, offset 1, own waiting period). Statute: LSA parental leave 61 alongside c5 from its start (c23).

The agreement's maternity and parental pay (100% for two weeks, then 100% of salary less expected EI) was written for the earlier two-week EI waiting period; per R21 EI starts one week after the leave (EI Act s. 13). The SUB requirements page (2018_05) caps SUB plus EI at 95% of normal weekly earnings for registered plans; the agreement states 100%, coded as written.

No relief from duties for new parents: 22.53 states the maternity and parental leaves 'shall not lead to any adjustment of the normal duties following the leave'; 22.87 no make-up of duties. Childcare (26.30-26.31) is a best-efforts facility commitment, not a component.

Leave for ASMs ineligible for supplemented leave (c10, c11; 22.66-22.67) covers term appointees in the first year; tenure-stream members are always eligible for supplemented leave (22.50), so these are recorded with the group named.
